answers.core: Localization is already a critical component of the engine that is supported out of the box. I believe that it needs a few rounds of QoL to make it easier to use before it becomes second nature to add localization in one's game.
answers.workaround: I believe this can be worked around with an editor plugin. However, having it so it updates the key list dynamically might need some kind of editor hook.

title: Implement selecting translation keys in the editor instead of entering them as strings
